items.title: Understanding the intelligence pyramid: Why most businesses know everything and do nothing?

The resource is intelligence: information that has been processed, placed in context, and converted into a decision within the window in which that decision still counts. Military history makes the point plainly. The intelligence failures that determined the outcomes of wars were rarely failures of collection; the signals were usually present.
